ownerName: Kampala Uganda Temple — LDS Church Special Projects
description: Manifest for the single deployable KUT project overlay pack. Copy this whole _BIM_COORD/ folder into the temple project folder (next to the central .rvt). Every file below merges over a corporate baseline shipped in StingTools/Data/ — project entries win by the stated merge key, so deploying this pack activates and localises, never forks. To start a pack for a different owner, copy this folder, edit each file, and update this manifest — nothing here is referenced by name from code.

files.overlays: TagConfig lookup tables (LOC_CODES / ZONE_CODES / sequence grouping)
files.mergeKey: whole-file replace of the keys present
files.purpose: Six-building campus LOC codes (BLD1..BLD6 + EXT) and per-building sequence grouping. The tag scheme's volume map depends on these codes existing.
Enables the kut-temple-example scheme (corporate ships it disabled) and maps LOC building codes to two-digit BEP volume codes.

files.mergeKey: milestone id, then categoryRules category (replace by category)
files.purpose: Restates the confirmed six-milestone ladder (deliverable-a 200 / -b 300 / -c 350 / conformed-set 350 / construction 400 / deliverable-d 500) as the client-facing record.
Enables the KUT sheet-number pattern, narrows the discipline taxonomy to the temple design team, and enables the ffe-fohlio-ref link check at severity WARN.
FF&E ↔ Fohlio column mapping. Link key FOHLIO_REF_TXT.
Sets CSI MasterFormat as the leading standard, because the Owner mandates RIB SpecLink.
Optional. The corporate baseline already carries a Kampala entry; deploy this only to replace it with engineer-confirmed ASHRAE 2021 Entebbe (HUEN / 636800) design values.

notInThisPack.why: A Revit parameter value; no repo file can set it. Blank silently falls back to BS EN 12056. See project-templates/KUT/README.md step 3.
Drives the sheet-number pattern and the tag scheme's projectInfo segments.
Holds an API key. A credential stub lives at docs/examples/KUT/fohlio_connection.json.example; the CSV Fohlio path needs no connection file at all.
